description:
I'm Cliff Hardesty. I've been climbing poles and running storm crews for a little electric
co-op in Kentucky for 34 years, and I still go out every time the ice comes in.

On this channel I tell you what happens on the other side of the outage: why some streets
come back first, what fails when the ice builds up, what homeowners do that keeps them in
the dark longer, and how to get your family through a week without power, safely.

A new video every week. Independent channel. I don't speak for any utility or co-op, and
anything inside your house is a job for a licensed electrician.

videos.title: Millions Bought Generators After the Last Storm — Linemen Know Why Most Won't Start
7 Things Linemen Do the Moment Their Own Power Goes Out (Most People Do #1 Backwards)
10 States Where the Grid Breaks First Every Winter (A Lineman Ranks Them)
What a Lineman Sees on the Pole Outside Your House That Means Trouble Is Coming
